s: Vanity of vanities: all is vanity. Everything passes, and there is nothing new under the sun.
The Preacher tried pleasure, work and wealth and found them empty.
There is a time for everything under heaven. God has put eternity in the human heart.
Oppression and rivalry are vanity. Two are better than one.
Be careful with your words before God. Riches do not satisfy.
Wealth without the ability to enjoy it is empty.
Sayings on wisdom, suffering and the shortness of life.
Obey the king. No one understands all of God's work.
The same fate comes to all, so enjoy life with those you love.
A little folly outweighs wisdom. Sayings about rulers and fools.
Cast your bread upon the waters. Enjoy your youth, knowing God will judge.
Remember your Creator in the days of your youth. Fear God and keep his commandments.

2: “Solicitous” here means anxious, full of worry.
